name: Timothy G. Leyh
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: The University of Michigan Law School
about: Timothy G. Leyh, an attorney with Bryan Cave Leighton Paisner LLP in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Business Litigation situations. He also helps clients with Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense concerns.
He received legal training from The University of Michigan Law School. He graduated from law school in 1984. Timothy Leyh became licensed to practice law in 1984.
Timothy Leyh was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2002 - 2026.
